title: Real-time Logistics Fleet Monitoring
business: Logistics companies managing large fleets of delivery vehicles.
problem: Delayed visibility into vehicle status leads to inefficient routing and missed delivery windows when unexpected traffic or mechanical issues occur.
solution: Azure Stream Analytics processes incoming telemetry data from vehicle IoT sensors in real-time using SQL-like queries to identify anomalies or route deviations instantly.
steps: Configure an Event Hub to ingest telemetry data streams from vehicle sensors.
Define an Azure Stream Analytics job to consume the Event Hub input.
Write a SQL-like query to aggregate sensor data over sliding time windows to detect patterns.
Route the processed insights to an output sink like Azure SQL Database or Power BI for immediate visualization.
outcome: Improved operational agility through immediate detection of fleet disruptions and proactive route adjustment.
limitation: The service requires careful management of input throughput; if the incoming data rate exceeds the provisioned streaming units, processing latency increases, which can be monitored via Azure Monitor metrics.
